description: GG-087 regression scenario: T4 live evaluation where p_t4 is well below (mip + vig), producing a negative gross_edge. The pre-fix bug pre-filtered gross_edge <= 0.0 as noise and hardcoded direction=YES, silently discarding this exact NO-side signal (measured at 41.6x the volume of the YES-side signal actually acted on). Post-fix, this resolves to an actionable NO bet. Also exercises the T4 paper-mode flow: RiskEngine.evaluate_forecast() approves a Kelly-derived size (pool_isolated=True, min_bet_usd override=1.0), which run_t4_mlb_live.py then REPLACES with a flat single-contract-at-market-price size (mip if YES else 1-mip) before calling open_position() -- this fixture pins both stages so a regression in either the Kelly-approval gate or the flat-size override formula fails the diff.
